title: Lace
description:
S01 E01 — Grapes of Wrath
Lacey has mastered the art of the deal, but as she builds influence, she's also making rivals on both sides of the law; as the lines of her business blur, one mishap or unexpected event may be all it takes for her operation to crumble.

title: Lace
description:
S01 E02 — Suspicious Vineyards
Othello and the twin enforcers meet with the billionaire husband of Daniel's alleged rape victim; Britney gets a call in the middle of the night that leads to a horrifying discovery; Daniel despairs in county lockup while Lacey tries to post bail.

title: Lace
description:
S01 E03 — Blood on the Leaves
An unnerved Lacey goes to the county jail, only to make a shocking discovery; Othello goes the extra mile to get leverage for a client who's getting low-balled on a mega real estate deal.

title: Lace
description:
S01 E04 — Through the Grapevine
Lacey takes on a new case, but has ulterior motives; Daniel tells Lacey about a possible new witness, but Lacey doubts his credibility.

title: Lace
description:
S01 E05 — You Reap What You Sow
Othello secures another win for the firm, but when he gets too close to Lacey, things don't go as expected; Lacey announces she's defending Deputy Garcia, but it proves to more than she bargained for.

title: Lace
description:
S01 E06 — New Wine
Lacey's enemies plot their revenge; Othello considers a compelling offer; Mark gets stunning news about Zoe; With the pressure mounting, Lacey begins to unravel.

title: Lace
description:
S02 E01 — Truth's Timing
The FBI investigation into "McCullough & Associates" shuts down Lacey's firm and assets; Lacey's convicted felon mother Tony remains in prison.

title: Lace
description:
S02 E02 — Smoke and Mirrors
Chelsea tells Lacey she's secured the meeting with her father, Gov. Barclay, who is the only one who can pardon Tony, but it will cost her; Lacey and Gideon meet to strategize about her defense.

title: Lace
description:
S02 E03 — Hedge of Protection
With Governor Barclay now at her mercy, things start to turn around for Lacey; Britney meets with Alphonso in jail and offers to represent him; Judge Sears vents at Peter Corbin's lack of results around Lacey.

title: Lace
description:
S02 E04 — Train Up a Child
Agent Diggs meets with Lacey's enemies; he tries to persuade them to work with the FBI and to testify against Lacey; Big D watches the Governor's insincere speech with contempt as he recycles what he said 20 years ago.

title: Lace
description:
S02 E05 — Seize Your Crown
Rev. McCullough welcomes back Tony as the First Lady of Holy Spirit church; during his draft workout for the LA Cheetahs, Frank Marzili advises Savoy not to sign with Daniel McCullough.

title: Lace
description:
S02 E06 — Overdue Diligence
With the newly acquired security footage from Randall's home, Judge Reinhart grants Lacey and Randall a new trial; Captain Warren Sloan congratulates Senator James Barclay on winning his special election.

title: Lace
description:
S02 E07 — A Blessing and a Curse
Tony escorts Britney into the warehouse for the first time; Randall and Daniel hold a press conference to announce their new venture; Sasha and Sloan enjoy their first real date as a couple; Lacey and Mark discuss their marriage issues.

title: Lace
description:
S02 E08 — Through the Valley
Judge Sharon Floyd and Big D broker a truce between Judge Sears and Tony; Randall offers to take Daniel under his wing; Chelsea confronts her father Sen. Barclay about Samantha; Lacey confronts Tony about Tony's new protégé Britney.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E01 — Yo Gotti Got the Next Date?
Angela opens up about her devastating breakup and the pressures of living in the spotlight; Vanessa throws a party to reunite the heirs and clear the air; Romeo gets caught up in a love triangle; Boogie's addiction takes a turn for the worse.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E02 — The Boy Is Mine
Tee Tee and Briana beef over Romeo's affections; Dame enlists Master P to scare Boogie straight; Angela moves to Los Angeles for a fresh start; Romeo hopes to get close to his former flame; red flags are raised over Egypt's relationship.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E03 — Game of Thrones
"Game of Thrones" game night at Pepa's house spirals into fight night; Dame and Pep clash over the severity of Boogie's addiction while Briana enters to confront a nasty rumor; Angela and Romeo reunite for the first time since Angela's breakup.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E04 — Blurred Lines
Angela and Romeo's Orlando, Fla., getaway leads to a hotel nightcap; Briana and Pepa clash at a releasing ceremony when Pepa brings alcoholic spirits; Boogie is blind-sided when he is led to a surprise drug intervention.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E05 — No More Boogie Nights
Boogie's intervention spirals out of control when Kristinia and Briana nearly come to blows; Romeo and Angela discuss their relationship; Angela drops a bomb on her and Vanessa's business plan; on the brink of destruction, Boogie checks into rehab.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E06 — A Ninja in the Shadows
Pepa's son, Tyran, comes to town with old baggage in tow; Tyran interrogates Egypt's boyfriend, Sam; drama ensues at a welcome party for Tyran; Master P is blindsided when he discovers that his incarcerated brother has gone on a hunger strike.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E07 — The Cupid Shuffle
The danger surrounding Master P's incarcerated brother comes to a head; Tee Tee plays cupid for Briana, but her grand plan backfires; Tyran struggles to get Pepa's attention; after a blow-up, Angela and Vanessa must unite for charity.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E08 — Straight Outta Rehab
Boogie is released from rehab and temptation strikes; Master P mentors the guys on a camping trip; family therapy with Pepa and her son, Tyran, bursts into flames; Kristinia meets her cousin Kyndall, El DeBarge's daughter, for the first time.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E09 — Tee Tee With the Good Hair
Angela and her siblings talk about marriage; Tee Tee goes on a first date with Romeo; Tee Tee's hair event sparks trouble when Kristinia's cousin, Kyndall, and her enemy, Briana, face off; since their fight-night blow-up, Pepa and Dame reunite.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E10 — Let's Talk About Sam
Marriage is on the radar; JoJo is pressed to make a proposal; Romeo is torn between Angela and Tee Tee; Egypt's bikini shoot takes a turn when her boyfriend, Sam, tries to take over; drama ensues when Pepa checks Egypt.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E11 — What Heirs in Vegas, Stays in Vegas
Kristinia moves to Sin City and throws a welcome party; the rivalry between Briana and Kristinia comes to a head; Romeo blindsides Tee Tee when he reveals he has a secret crush on another woman; panic strikes when Egypt and Sam run off to elope.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E12 — Hard Times
Angela is shell-shocked when she suffers a major loss; Romeo runs to Angela's side; Boogie betrays his family to avoid his father, Dame; a dispute between the Pepas comes to a head at Romeo's yacht party, where a table gets flipped and fists fly.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E13 — Meet Your New Daddy
Angela is blindsided when Vanessa takes business matters into her own hands; Pepa's security guard turned boyfriend violates his new father-figure role; a disgruntled Briana comes for Tee Tee; in a long-awaited reunion, Dame unleashes on Boogie.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E14 — This Ain't My First Rodeo
Boogie and Dame have a meet-up; sparks fly between Romeo and Angela; Angela avoids Vanessa at the racetrack and pushes her to her breaking point; a shocking scandal rocks Pepa's world when Aundre's past comes back to haunt him; with bonus footage.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E15 — Don't Get It Twisted
Lil Twist brings trouble to Dame's Culture Vulture Event which threatens Sam; Twist has eyes for Egypt; Romeo stands up to Master P and gets blowback; a scandal from Aundre's past jeopardizes Pepa's million-dollar deal; with bonus footage.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E16 — The Battle of the Lil's
Romeo and Bow Wow face off in an epic battle of the Lils; Pepa feels conflicted about her career and her relationship; on a romantic stroll in New Orleans, Angela and Romeo take shocking steps to move forward in their relationship.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E17 — Wherefore Art Thou Romeo?
Angela and Romeo's double date backfires; Pepa's relationship with Aundre takes a turn for the worse; Tee Tee throws a singles party during which an uninvited guest pops up with a vengeance; Sam and Lil Twist nearly come to blows over Egypt.

title: Growing Up Hip Hop
description:
S04 E18 — Leave Me Alone
Romeo finds himself in hot water with Angela when he drops out of their double date; Dame confronts his nemesis; Pepa struggles with a broken heart; Master P warns Eric about digging up Eazy-E's death; Vanessa gets a birthday surprise.
